observations.text: The Praxis manifest identifies repository cwchewang/go2-mujoco-control, issue 159, the frozen branch, starting commit and task document; live-start.txt records the same five PRAXIS identity values and start time 2026-09-23T14:22:18.509644909Z.

At 2026-09-23T14:22:38.526603Z, the process snapshot lists three praxis_v2.cli run processes (PIDs 216157, 216159, 216161) and three codex exec processes (PIDs 216269, 216306, 216502); command arguments and environment values are omitted.
Git rejected the initial tracking-branch command; the named local branch was then created at the frozen commit and the committed result has that exact parent.
The first commit attempt failed because no author name was configured; the subsequent retry created the recorded commit.
The committed result states that no physics, GPU, or scientific work ran; the task document also sets this task's zero-physics infrastructure boundary.

inferences.text: The timestamps place the process sample about 20.017 seconds after the start and the end about 32.812 seconds after the sample, spanning the two required wait intervals.
The six matching process records in one snapshot demonstrate coexistence of three Praxis run processes and three Codex executions at that sampled instant.

The commit parent equals the frozen starting commit, its sole changed path is the authorized result document, and the final status is clean; the frozen task document therefore remains unchanged in this commit.

conclusions.text: The individual Go2 A task's required live-overlap capture and tracked-result commit are complete, with direct process evidence at the recorded sample and a clean, single-file commit on the requested branch.

uncertainty.text: One process snapshot establishes coexistence only at that instant; it does not establish uninterrupted overlap throughout the full interval or global isolation across the three independent tasks. Praxis must compare their separate evidence intervals and snapshots.
